# ScanSolve

> ScanSolve is QR-code maintenance reporting. Place a QR code label anywhere in your building — staff scan it with a phone camera to report a maintenance issue or fault instantly, no app or login required. Managers get real-time visibility and track every issue (work order) through to resolution. It is an alternative to per-seat CMMS and maintenance-request software (MaintainX, UpKeep, Limble, SafetyCulture): the whole team reports for free and pricing is one flat price per organisation, not per user.

## Product

- **Homepage**: https://scansolve.co
- **Sign up**: https://scansolve.co/auth?mode=signup
- **Manager login**: https://scansolve.co/auth

## What ScanSolve Does

ScanSolve lets facility managers print QR code labels and place them anywhere a problem might occur — toilets, plant rooms, gym equipment, retail floors, hotel rooms, train carriages. When someone notices an issue, they scan the code with their phone camera, fill in a short form (category, optional description, optional photo), and submit. No app download needed, no account required.

The facility manager receives a notification and can assign the issue to a team member, track its status through Assigned → In Progress → Resolved, and view all open issues across every location from a single dashboard.

## Who It's For

- Facilities managers and building managers
- Office managers
- Hotel and hospitality operations teams
- Gym and leisure centre operators
- Retail and shop floor managers
- Schools and educational facilities
- Rail and transport operators
- Residential block management companies
- FM (facilities management) companies

## Key Features

- QR code label generation and printing
- Zero-friction issue reporting (no app, no login for reporters)
- Real-time dashboard with issue tracking
- Photo uploads with issue reports
- Email notifications and assignment workflow
- AI-powered issue category suggestions
- Multi-location support
- Free forever on the Starter plan with unlimited QR labels; Prime is a flat per-organisation price (no per-seat charge)
